inspected_statements.locator: Introduction, definition of simple rational function
inspected_statements.statement: A degree-d simple rational function has form psi(z)/(z-p), with deg psi=d and psi(p) nonzero.
inspected_statements.application: The existing real-Hurwitz framework concerns the same two-pole profile (d-1,1), rather than a different denominator.

inspected_statements.statement: For a fixed ordered real branch set and prescribed profiles, normalized real simple rational functions correspond bijectively to their real dessins.
inspected_statements.application: Primary context for the real-cover realization and chamber framework. The note writes the hemisphere gluing explicitly for its paired-simple-critical specialization.

inspected_statements.statement: The stated nonvanishing criterion concerns a generating series allowing additional simple branch values.
inspected_statements.application: It is not used to assert nonvanishing of the individual zero-additional-branch coefficient or rational descent of this passport.
